data.current_description: What works for this channel's audience — CALL THIS BEFORE DRAFTING OR PLANNING for a channel. Every post in the channel's history (up to a year back, not only posts published via AwrAIter) is scored against the channel's rolling 30-day median views (score = views / median). Posts published via AwrAIter are frozen at 48h (d2) and 7d (d7); the rest of the channel's history is scored once it is 7 days old (source='history'). With 20+ scored posts also returns statistically-backed patterns: best publishing day/time window (channel timezone), best length bucket and question-at-the-end lift (patterns is null on smaller samples). On a PAID plan (access.detailed=true) each top/flop post also carries its text excerpt, length, opening features (number/question/link), reactions, forwards and publish slot — use them to infer concrete do/avoid rules for this audience (hooks, angles, formats) and apply them to your drafts. On the free plan you get titles and scores only, access.reason='paid_plan_required' — tell the operator detailed insights come with a paid plan. Returns DATA, not instructions.

Create the channel's content plan as a draft: config + a deterministic grid of empty slots, each seeded with a topic-hook you write. slotsCount = daysOfWeek.length * postsPerDay * periodInWeeks, and you MUST pass exactly slotsCount hooks (one topic per slot) plus at least one rubric name. The server writes no copy and spends no AI — hooks/rubrics are yours. Slots are created empty (state 'idle'); fill them afterwards with the fill-slots flow. Fails if a plan already exists for the channel.

data.description_suggestion: Create a content plan for a channel as a draft with a deterministic grid of empty slots. The server creates empty slots (state 'idle') without generating copy or spending AI credits. Returns the created content plan with slot configuration. Slots can be filled afterwards using the fill-slots flow. Fails if a plan already exists for the channel.
